title: Decentralized Project Reputation
tagline: On-chain star ratings for crypto projects and user can add comments and reviews
description:
On-chain star ratings for crypto projects and user can add comments and reviews
 
How it works:
- User can fill out a form for a project to be rating and get review and comments
- User can rate a project from 0-5
- User can also comment on the projects

Contacts:
- Scroll Testnet => 0xB7041238e3f1985b0a6A2AC07d48335E262aaF3E
how_its_made:
I built the Dapp with React and use Chakra UI for styling.  I built the contract with Hardhat.  I deploy my contracts on Scroll Testnet.

I used the following technologies:
- Polybase - Project data are stored in Polybase
- Scroll - I deployed the contract on Scroll Testnet for cheap gas fee
- Graph - I created a subgraph
